name: Brie
description: Research repository for Brie: LLM-assisted data authoring methodology. 1,213 hand-authored examples, three small base models (Qwen 2.5 3B, Llama 3.2 3B, Qwen 2.5 0.5B), blind multi-judge A/B validation across two judge generations (2025 + 2026). Training code, evaluation pipeline, and Zenodo paper.
